description: Export terrain tiles of a map as OBJ with a texture, headless. Give a map id from wow_map_search plus tiles, or a world position. Texture modes: 'tex0' blends the tile's layers into one PNG (default), 'alpha' writes the layer textures and blend masks, 'none' is geometry only. Optionally places the tile's buildings and props. Written to <outputDir>/maps/<directory>/. Baked high-resolution textures are not supported (they need a GPU).

flavor.description: Which installed client to read: mainline (retail), forever, classic or vanilla. Defaults to the first install found.

objects.description: Also export the tile's WMO and M2 placements. Slow.

outputDir.description: Folder to write into (created if missing).

tiles.description: Tile pairs [a, b] from the file name map_a_b.adt.

x.description: World x (north); with y, picks the tile.

name: wow_map_export
title: Export map terrain
